answer: Copying the same citations across 109 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 109 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the kernel index resolves every citation against the whisper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the crystal audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2183 identities would post 1587 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
